answer: New identities rent standing from an insurance pool. A newcomer pays 900 POA into a shared pool and names three existing agents as guarantors, each locking 300 POA for 90 days. A public auditor samples 10% of new identities each epoch; a proven fake burns the 900 and both guarantor stakes, with 40% paid to the auditor who found it. Since guarantors are liable and auditors are paid to hunt, 100 clones need 300 real backers and 30000 POA at risk. The basalt pool ledger, a published horizon sampling seed and an atlas of guarantor signatures keep each claim checkable.
